source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: Your family name carries weight in high society. You are welcome wherever nobility is welcomed and can always secure an audience with local nobles or officials by announcing your family name. Additionally, your family's legal standing provides protection. Once per arc you can invoke your family's influence to have a minor legal infraction committed by you or your companions overlooked before consequences take effect, provided the relevant authority has reason to respect your name.
